index.title: AI-gile: your AI dev team, on one board
index.description: A kanban board for AI coding teams, AI-gile is. While you sleep, they work; one short pile of things to decide, test and accept, you get.
hero.h1.html: Your AI dev team, on one board, it is.
hero.alphaTitle: Early and unfinished, it is: thank you for trying it, we do!
hero.lede: While you sleep, they build. Wake up to one short pile, you will: a few questions, a few things to test, a purple diamond or two. Click, accept, and back to your coffee, you go.
hero.secondary: Agile, but a stand-up coffee, the team never needs. (Stand-ups anyway, they do.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile in as many words as you like
pitch.lede: Pick a length, you may, from one word to 144. Its own description, each length is, written for that size. Drag the slider, or the arrow keys use.
count.line.html.one: {n} card on the board right now, there is
count.line.html.other: {n} cards on the board right now, there are
f.pile.html: For you holds everything waiting on you, across every project: questions, things to test, tasks only a human can do. What is next and how long it takes, your queue tells.
f.sleep.h: Teams that work while you sleep
f.sleep.p: A lead and a team of AI agents, each project has. Comment on a card, and wakes up the team does; the work it does, and back it hands it, with steps a tired human can follow.
f.tester.p: Before anything reaches you, the steps in a copy of the app a tester follows, and what it saw, with a screenshot, it shows. Flick through the passed ones you can, and accept in a click.
f.proof.p: What changed, every hand-over shows: the files, the diff, the screenshots. Open every app to see if done it is, you need not.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail, it is: one icon per project, purple diamonds for what needs you. Message a lead an idea, and into cards and a plan they turn it, with a ✅ Go button.
f.tidy.p: Into one, related cards fold; fixed, muddled titles get; lean, a token check keeps the code. Fewer things to switch between, less to think about, there is.
f.private.li1: On your own machine the board runs, and only to you it answers.
f.private.li2: End-to-end encrypted, private DMs between people are.
f.private.li3: No accounts, no trackers, no cookies, there are.
f.lang.p: Over 120 languages, there are, from Dutch, Welsh and Japanese to pirate, Yoda and Klingon, with a quick switch back to English for the industry jargon.
f.service.h: From an idea to a real service, hmm
f.service.p: Built something with AI that now people use, have you? As a service mark it, and run it well the board helps you: uptime checks, a public status page, incidents with a write-up, changes that a Go need, backups daily checked. Each step as you go, Help teaches.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: in your pocket, your team is
msgr.p1: To your AI team talk, without opening the board. With your project leads and your friends chat, and a card's test steps see and answer them, all from your phone.
msgr.p2: To pair it, a QR code on your board scan. First time? Show you around, a friendly demo chat will.
msgr.when: Android first, then a web version for phones and iPhone.
msgr.b1: Ready, the dark mode fix is. The test steps, want them you do?
msgr.b3: 1. Settings, open. 2. Dark, pick. Right, does it look?

privacy.title: AI-gile: what we keep
privacy.lede: Short version: only what you send us, and not for long.
privacy.only: Only what you send us, we keep: what into a form you type, like your email. Nothing else about you.
privacy.sealed: Sealed it is, so read it our server cannot: in your browser, before it leaves (on an older browser, the moment it arrives). Only our own board can open it.
privacy.server: Deleted from the server it is, as soon as our board it reaches. Still there after 30 days, anything is? Deleted anyway, it is.
privacy.board: On our board we keep it, only until replied to you we have. Then delete it there too, we do.
privacy.none: No trackers, no cookies, no analytics, there are.
privacy.local: In your own browser, your language and light or dark choice stay. Sent to us, they never are.
privacy.ask: Gone sooner, want it you do? Reply to our email, and say so.
